summary: The organic-starter rewrite changes only solver-visible application logic plus reference-solution mechanics; it does not introduce a packaging, privilege, networking or dependency violation. The current task retains top-level Edition 3 metadata, digest-pinned matching Debian agent/verifier bases, separate verifier execution, pinned pytest, .dockerignore answer isolation, ordinary resource limits and public network mode. The new solution filter/runtime-repair scripts are deterministic local transformations with no network fetch or hidden-verifier access.

evidence.observation: Current Edition 3 top-level category/subcategory/tags/languages/difficulty/expert estimate/artifacts placement remains intact; separate verifier and bounded timeouts remain configured.
Agent image remains digest-pinned Debian bookworm-slim, installs required tools in one apt layer and copies only eod/.
Solution, tests, VCS metadata, caches, env files and archives remain excluded from the agent build context.
Verifier remains separate on the same digest-pinned base with pytest==8.4.1 pinned at build time.
New helper filters known organically rewritten runtime files out of the legacy aggregate patch; it reads/writes local temporary files only.
Reference solution combines local patch parts, filters them, applies direct runtime/schema repairs and executes the real batch; no network or privilege escalation is used.
Preflight, Ruff, Docker/STB, Oracle and NOP pass on current organic-starter merge ref ec40c51... .

do_not_change: Do not copy solution/tests into the agent image.
Do not add runtime package downloads, Docker socket access or privileged execution.
